name: Dr Omar Haddad
focus: Sleep disrupted by travel and shift work
quote: People who travel for work don't need a lecture about jet lag. They need a plan that survives a Tuesday in Singapore.
bio: Omar looks after many of the members who live partly out of a suitcase. He trained in general practice and spent several years in remote and expedition medicine before settling in London.

He is practical by temperament: vaccination schedules planned around a year of travel, a doctor's letter for the medicines in a hand-luggage bag, a sensible approach to sleep across time zones. He runs the Saturday morning clinic, which is often the only time his patients are in the country.
background: General practice, with a background in remote and expedition medicine. Leads Aurevia's travel medicine service.
